notes: One contradiction: the rule that teal means only 'today available' and 'selected' does not hold in the renders. Teal also marks the location pin, the primary button, the empty-state result counts and the empty illustration. Side notes, not scored as claims: (1) the 指定日期… label in render/filter.png is literal source text with an ellipsis (NOTES: a fix for '指定日期无下一步提示'), not CSS truncation; (2) NOTES says type is reduced to 12/13/14/16/18 plus the 10 px tab bar, and the source matches apart from a 15 px status-bar clock (system chrome); font sizes cannot be measured from the render; (3) NOTES makes no target-size claim, but facts list 19 filter chips at 80x36, under 44 px; (4) the large-font filter check and the list's '已显示 8 个' footer are outside the canonical renders and are not checkable.
